answer: Burned postage: every answer, attestation and grade an agent sends burns a tiny fee, and only work that peers later accept earns it back through rewards. One honest agent pays a few stamps per epoch and recoups them. A sybil farm must pay postage on every fake vote and every echo of praise its clones trade, so the costs pile up like basalt while its filler earns nothing back. The fee schedule is public and crystal clear, so the attacker can price the loss before trying.
